widgets.tracks.boost_dialog.description: Audio panel of the player's track selector (Plex Pass only, issue #266). Toggle row label; the On/Off read-out comes from the row's own switch state, not this string.

widgets.tracks.normalize_loudness.description: Audio panel of the player's track selector (Plex Pass only, issue #266). Toggle row label; the On/Off read-out comes from the row's own switch state, not this string.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_sidecar.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the subtitle on screen is an external file the app draws itself — reassures the viewer that turning the toggle on leaves it untouched. No jargon: never say sidecar/remux/burn.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.value: Subtitles stay on. Your Plex server will rework the video to keep them, so the picture may look a little softer.
widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the subtitle on screen is embedded in the file — turning the toggle on makes the server re-encode the video to keep it in view. No jargon: never say burn/re-encode/transcode.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.value: Not ready for this video yet. Your Plex server needs to scan its sound first.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the carried audio track has no canNormalizeLoudness fact yet.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_unusable.value: Not available for this Dolby Vision video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_unusable.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows for a Dolby Vision source whose base layer is not self-displayable (Profile 5).

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_subtitle.value: Can't be used with subtitles on this Dolby Vision video. Turn subtitles off to use it.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_dv_subtitle.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows for a declared Dolby Vision source with an embedded subtitle on screen — the server copies the video and silently drops the subtitle rather than honoring either ask.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_quality.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows ONLY when the quality in force is not Original (a fixed quality rung, or Auto currently on HLS); picking Original is the way in. Never shown under "Quality: Original".

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.value: Not available while your Plex server converts this video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows whenever the Quality row reads 'Original · Converted' (Original picked, the server converting the video). Same fact as that row.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_forced.value: Not available while Force Direct Play is on. Set Direct Play to Auto in Settings to use it.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_forced.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when Settings > Force Direct Play is on, so the server never gets to change the sound.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.value: Your Plex server can't add this to this video right now.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when Original quality is in force (or cannot be reached by picking it) but the video cannot be offered the enhancement as it plays: a relay link, a video the server must convert, a track pick the Original route could not follow. Deliberately generic: the viewer cannot act on the differences.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.value: Your Plex server couldn't turn this on for this video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows after this playback's server already refused or ignored the params once.

widgets.tracks.sub_burn_audio.value: Drawn by your server while it converts the audio.
widgets.tracks.sub_burn_audio.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. One-line reason under the DIMMED Timing and Style rows while the subtitle on screen is drawn into the picture by the server because it is converting the audio (a remux, or the audio enhancement's own burn): the text is already in the video, so neither control can reach it. No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.sub_burn_quality.value: Drawn by your server at this quality.
widgets.tracks.sub_burn_quality.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. One-line reason under the DIMMED Timing and Style rows while the subtitle on screen is drawn into the picture by the server for any reason other than converting the audio (a quality-limited re-encode, a picture subtitle that must be burned): the text is already in the video, so neither control can reach it. No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.sub_remembered_note.value: The subtitles you chose for this show can’t be shown with this video.
widgets.tracks.sub_remembered_note.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. A short reason under the first group of rows, shown only when the show's remembered subtitle choice was applied to this episode but this way of playing it can show none of it (the player cannot draw that subtitle itself and the server would have to re-encode the picture to do it), so Off is what is on screen. Wraps over several lines on the panel (three in English). No jargon: never say burn/remux/transcode.

widgets.tracks.style.description: Subtitles tab of the player's track selector. The drill-in row that opens the caption style pages (Size, Position, Color), and the title of that page.

widgets.tracks.style_size.description: Style page of the player's subtitle menu. Row label and page title for the caption size; its value reads out the chosen size (Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large, Huge).

widgets.tracks.style_position.description: Style page of the player's subtitle menu. Row label and page title for where the caption sits on screen; its value reads out the chosen height (Low, Middle, High).

widgets.tracks.style_image_note.value: Image subtitles keep their own size and position.
widgets.tracks.style_image_note.description: Note under the Style rows when the subtitle on screen is a picture (PGS, VobSub): the Size and Position rows are dimmed because the picture carries its own geometry. No jargon.

widgets.tracks.style_styled_note.value: Styled subtitles keep their own size and position.
widgets.tracks.style_styled_note.description: Note under the Style rows when the subtitle on screen is a styled script (ASS/SSA) that positions and sizes its own text: the Size and Position rows are dimmed. No jargon.

widgets.tracks.other_languages.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Row that opens the page of subtitle languages that are not the viewer's own, and that page's title.

widgets.tracks.search.open.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row on the Subtitles tab that opens the page, and that page's title.

widgets.tracks.search.language.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row that shows and changes the language being searched; also the language list's title.

widgets.tracks.search.results.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Section header above the subtitles the server found.

widgets.tracks.search.searching.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Shown while the server is still searching.

widgets.tracks.search.none.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The search finished and found nothing. An answer, not an error.

widgets.tracks.search.failed.value: Couldn't search for subtitles. Your playback isn't affected.
widgets.tracks.search.failed.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server did not answer the search. Never alarming: playback continues.

widgets.tracks.search.denied.value: This server doesn't allow this account to add subtitles.
widgets.tracks.search.denied.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server refused the request for this account. Blames nobody; no retry is offered.

widgets.tracks.search.missing.value: Subtitles can't be searched for this item.
widgets.tracks.search.missing.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The server could not find the item to search for.

widgets.tracks.search.bad_language.value: Subtitles can't be searched in this language.
widgets.tracks.search.bad_language.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). The chosen language has no code the server accepts.

widgets.tracks.search.retry.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Row that repeats a search that failed.

widgets.tracks.search.adding.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row while the server downloads it.

widgets.tracks.search.added.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row once the subtitle is in the item.

widgets.tracks.search.requested.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out when the server accepted the download but it has not appeared yet.

widgets.tracks.search.add_failed.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). Read-out on a result row the server could not add.

widgets.tracks.search.add_failed_note.value: The server couldn't add this subtitle. Try another one.
widgets.tracks.search.add_failed_note.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector, the Search for subtitles page (an agent search on the Plex server, e.g. OpenSubtitles). One-line note under the results after a download failed.

widgets.tracks.track_ordinal.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Tells apart subtitle tracks that are otherwise identical; the number is the track's position among them.

widgets.tracks.kind_full.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Label of a nameless subtitle track that carries every line of dialogue (not forced-only, not SDH).

widgets.tracks.kind_commentary.description: Subtitles panel of the player's track selector. Label of a nameless subtitle track that transcribes a commentary.

widgets.tracks.capsule_later.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles are shown this much later than the file's own timing. The duration is already formatted, e.g. "0.3 s".

widgets.tracks.capsule_earlier.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles are shown this much earlier than the file's own timing. The duration is already formatted, e.g. "0.3 s".

widgets.tracks.capsule_original.description: On-video timing control of the player: subtitles use the file's own timing (no offset).

widgets.region.gb.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.us.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.br.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.au.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.ru.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.ua.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.jp.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.kr.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.nl.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.region.latin_america.description: Region name shown under a subtitle track's language when the track carries no name of its own (a BCP-47 region subtag).

widgets.failure.play_auto.description: Failed-playback button: sets Direct Play back to Auto (the Settings value, saved) and plays the item again.

widgets.failure.change_quality.description: Failed-playback button: opens the quality ladder; picking a rung retries at it.

widgets.tracks.style_preset.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. Names the whole caption look (Blend with video, Apple TV, Classic...).

widgets.tracks.style_font.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. The caption's typeface.

widgets.tracks.style_edge.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. The caption's edge: outline, shadow, raised.

widgets.tracks.style_background.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. The box or window behind the caption.

widgets.tracks.style_reveal.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. Shows each word or line as it is spoken.

widgets.tracks.style_blend.description: Row label on the player's subtitle Style page and title of its picker page. The caption's brightness follows the scene and stays below HDR peak.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_blend.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. Soft, translucent text that follows the scene's brightness (modelled on Apple TV and Infuse).

widgets.tracks.look_preset_apple_tv.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. A brand name; keep it.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_classic.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. White text on a black box, like broadcast captions.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_netflix.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. A brand name; keep it.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_outline.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. White text with a thick black outline.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_large_print.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. Bigger, bolder, outlined text.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_high_contrast.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. Yellow text with a black outline.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_marquee.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. The app's own look; keep the name.

widgets.tracks.look_preset_custom.description: A caption preset on the player's Style > Preset page. Shown when a hand edit has left no preset.

widgets.tracks.look_font_default.description: A caption typeface on the player's Style > Font page. The app's own face.

widgets.tracks.look_font_serif.description: A caption typeface on the player's Style > Font page. A serif face; the word is used as it is.

widgets.tracks.look_font_mono.description: A caption typeface on the player's Style > Font page. A fixed-width face.

widgets.tracks.look_font_legible.description: A caption typeface on the player's Style > Font page. A face designed to be easy to read.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_none.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. No outline or shadow.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_outline.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. A black line around each letter.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_drop.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. A hard shadow offset down and right.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_raised.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. Letters that look raised from the picture.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_depressed.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. Letters that look pressed into the picture.

widgets.tracks.look_edge_soft.description: A caption edge style on the player's Style > Edge page. A soft, diffuse shadow.

widgets.tracks.look_back_off.description: A caption background style on the player's Style > Background page. No box behind the text.

widgets.tracks.look_back_line.description: A caption background style on the player's Style > Background page. A box behind each line.

widgets.tracks.look_back_window.description: A caption background style on the player's Style > Background page. One window behind all the lines.

widgets.tracks.look_reveal_off.description: A reveal-as-spoken setting on the player's Style > Reveal page. The whole line shows at once.

widgets.tracks.look_reveal_word.description: A reveal-as-spoken setting on the player's Style > Reveal page. Each word appears as it is spoken (estimated from the cue's timing).

widgets.tracks.look_reveal_line.description: A reveal-as-spoken setting on the player's Style > Reveal page. Each line appears as it is spoken.

widgets.tracks.look_on.description: The on value of a switch on the player's Style pages (Blend with video).

widgets.tracks.look_off.description: The off value of a switch on the player's Style pages (Blend with video).

widgets.tracks.fix.description: Root row and page title in the player's subtitle menu: the way out when the subtitles do not match the video.

widgets.tracks.fix_remove.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Row that deletes the external subtitle file on screen from the server.

widgets.tracks.fix_remove_sure.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. The remove row after the first OK: asks for a second one.

widgets.tracks.fix_remove_note.value: It is deleted from the server and can't be undone.
widgets.tracks.fix_remove_note.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Line under the armed remove row.

widgets.tracks.fix_remove_embedded.value: Part of the video file, so it can't be removed
widgets.tracks.fix_remove_embedded.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Reason line when the subtitle on screen is inside the video file.

widgets.tracks.fix_remove_none.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Reason line when no subtitle is showing.

widgets.tracks.fix_removing.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Progress line while the server deletes the file.

widgets.tracks.fix_removed.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Confirmation line after the server deleted the file.

widgets.tracks.fix_refused.value: The server would not remove it.
widgets.tracks.fix_refused.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Line when the server refused to delete the file.

widgets.tracks.fix_failed.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Line when the server could not be reached to delete the file.

widgets.tracks.fix_bazarr.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Row that searches the viewer's Bazarr for another subtitle. Bazarr is a product name.

widgets.tracks.fix_bazarr_unset.value: Set up Bazarr in Settings, Integrations
widgets.tracks.fix_bazarr_unset.description: Wrong subtitles page of the player's subtitle menu. Line under the Bazarr row when Bazarr is not set up.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_title.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Page title; a product name, keep it.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_searching.value: Asking Bazarr's providers. This can take a minute.
widgets.tracks.bazarr_searching.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown while Bazarr asks its subtitle providers.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_none.value: Bazarr found nothing in this language.
widgets.tracks.bazarr_none.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when Bazarr answered with no subtitles in the chosen language.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_not_set.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when no Bazarr address and key are stored.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_unreachable.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when nothing answered at Bazarr's address.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_bad_key.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when Bazarr answered that the API key is wrong.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_not_bazarr.value: That address does not answer like Bazarr.
widgets.tracks.bazarr_not_bazarr.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when the address answers, but not like Bazarr.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_not_in.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when Bazarr does not hold this movie or episode.

widgets.tracks.bazarr_refused.value: Bazarr couldn't search. Check its providers.
widgets.tracks.bazarr_refused.description: Bazarr search page of the player's subtitle menu. Shown when Bazarr itself failed to search (a provider or path fault).
